portInfo.description: The British Virgin Islands Ports Authority manages the Cyril B. Romney Tortola Pier Park cruise pier in Road Town: 1,312 feet long by 60 feet wide, re-engineered for ships up to 180,000 GRT, explicitly excluding Oasis-class vessels above 200,000 GRT, with capacity for two large ships at anchor plus pier operations (up to four ships) and an adjacent tender pier. BVIPA notes a turning basin 0.4 miles south-southeast with radius over 300 metres and minimum depth 11.3 metres, and records expansions (1994 / 1999 / 2015) plus the 15 February 2019 renaming. The landside five-acre Pier Park (11 buildings, 18 kiosks, 70+ retail units) is operated with Tortola Pier Park Ltd at Wickhams Cay I. Do not confuse the deep cruise pier with the shallower Road Town Jetty ferry facility (190 m / 3.65 m) also listed by BVIPA.

facts.established: Historic port dating to colonial era
facts.significance: Main port of the British Virgin Islands

politics.visaRequirements: Visa-free for most visitors for up to 30 days
politics.entryRequirements: Valid passport required. Some nationalities may need visa.

gettingThere.fromTerminal: Cyril B. Romney Tortola Pier Park — 1312×60 ft; ≤180k GRT; door null
gettingThere.walkingTime: 5-10 minutes to town center—confirm on your sailing programme before you rely on a fixed walk time.
gettingThere.publicTransport: Pier Park is at the pier. Road Town centre minutes unverified. Cane Garden Bay / North Shore taxis need 75–120 min buffers on busy days.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: Road Town stroll — walk minutes unverified.
Beach / island tours — taxi; standard+ calls.
Tortola Pier Park retail / Road Town
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: If your ship anchors, budget tender time separately from the alongside pier day.
